items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free style cleanse that won't add to dryness or redness while you sort out next steps.
A ceramide moisturizer to support a skin barrier that scans on the drier side.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection, which suits skin that looks a little reactive.

response.routine_note: Because three months of chemist products haven't changed how your skin looks, a dermatologist is a better next step than adding more products from a shop. Until then, cleanse gently, moisturize, wear sunscreen every morning, and hold off on new actives.
